versions.content: The CanTp shall reject the request for receive cancellation in case of a Single Frame reception or if the CanTp is in the process of receiving the last Consecutive Frame of the N - SDU (i.e. the service is called after N - Cr timeout is started for the last Consecutive Frame). In this case the CanTp shall return E_NOT_OK.
